name: Shadow Spectre

bonuses.name: Intense Emotions
bonuses.text: This Threat takes a penalty of +1 DN to all Resolve Tests.

bonuses.name: Shadow Spectre Jetpack
bonuses.text: A jetpack is built into the Shadow Spectre's Heavy Aspect Armour, and their sophisticated technology allows them to fly at their Speed +4, and do not need to make Pilot (A) Tests unless called for by the GM.

bonuses.name: Spectre Holo-Field
bonuses.text: Shadow Spectres gain +1 Defence and +1 bonus die on Stealth (A) Tests (bonuses included above).

abilities.name: Battle Focus
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin immediately before or after making a ranged attack to Move up to the Warp Spider's Speed as a Free Action.

options.name: Shadow Spectre Exarch
options.text: A Shadow Spectre Exarch has Weapon Skill 9 and 9 Wounds. They lose their Prism Rifle, and gain the equipment and bonuses below: Prism Blaster: 16 +3 ED / AP -3 / Range 12 - 24 - 36 / Salvo 2 / Assault; Champion: An Exarch may use Ruin Actions; Ghostlight: Shadow Spectres within 10m of their Exarch gain +8 bonus dice on Leadership (Wil) Tests during Combined Attacks (Wrath & Glory, page 188) involving multiple Shadow Spectres.

note: Speed printed '12 (Fly)'; stored 12. Battle Focus names the Warp Spider (copied from the Warp Spider block, as printed).
